craft_notes: Sthāyin: secret-joy. Close: mistress. Rejected: 'bosom' — killed; 'queen' — killed: mistress kept.

lines: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the heart-dwelling Power,
l4.sanskrit_cite: etadguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā

reads_against.argmap: The secret asked is the heart-abiding Kaulikī, mistress of the clan.
